Outstanding Food!
Aug 2022 • Family
Wow! This place is a bit out of the way if you are staying in District 1 or 3, but well worth the $8 taxi ride. We (party of 4) found it a bit by accident while researching places off the normal tourist maps. It is located on the second floor of the Q Industries building with a small sign out front. Don’t let the location fool you. It is an outstanding restaurant. Service from the time we sat down until we got up to leave was impeccable. The interior decor has a great vibe with seating for around 40 people. They are only open for lunch currently (from 11:00 am until 2:00 pm) with a very nice set (2 or 3 course) a la carte menu with multiple selection options and a daily special menu with 5 dishes that changes every couple weeks. We had one of each of the 5 specials (rib eye steak, soft shell crab, seafood fried rice, Thai curry dusted grilled chicken, and pork/beef satay combination). Add to that 2 bottles of Prosecco, desserts and tea. The chef (Nalinda Prabath Rajasuriya) came to our table to ensure the dishes were satisfactory, and ended up chatting with us for about 5 minutes. I can’t stress what a wonderful experience it was. Make it a “must” the next time you’re in Saigon.

Great place to hang out for good food & ambience
Jul 2022 • Friends
So happy the restaurant has reopened after COVID. The set lunch menu is a great help to those who always have difficulty deciding what to order.

The choice of cuisine covers both Asian and Western, and the food is well prepared and well presented - good as it has always been. Small things like the sambal chilli paste that comes with the Kway Teow and the cookie that comes with the latte, all made in-house, make for pleasant little surprises that make you want to go back.

Looking forward to trying out other cuisines on their ever changing lunch menu.
